_sandbox_exec.note: Isolated code execution in the k3d `sandbox` namespace (deny-all NetworkPolicy + ResourceQuota + sandbox_monitor auto-quarantine; fail-closed on the reconcile race; pod auto-deleted). Enabled where EXECUTE stays denied because it is isolated-by-construction. Advertised here + in bifrost_shell_policy.json (SANDBOX class) + the gateway launcher --tools allowlist. Requires kubectl + scoped RBAC in the bifrost-shell-mcp container (Dockerfile + gateway launcher, non-protected infra).

outcome_history.task: stalerow: one tool of five cooperating functions (as_date, days_apart, classify, counts, quiet_ids) doing date arithmetic on string dates, graded by an 18-check seeded test
outcome_history.result: FAILED 7 of 7 on this tier: C38 7/8, C46 8/9, C49 1/10, C52 6/17, C55 8/17, C58 13/17, and X30 7/18 on the exact brief and test that the t2-gemma4 tier (A30) and the Bifrost granite tool tier (HX30) each passed 18/18 on the first attempt
outcome_history.finding: Multi-function date calls are past this tier's ceiling. It spends its turns reading the test piece by piece instead of fixing on the test's failures, misreads shape descriptions as literals, and runs out at 18 turns. The cause is the tier, not the contract: X30 held the contract fixed.
outcome_history.route: Send multi-function date-arithmetic builds to bifrost-t2-gemma4 (Lane A) or the Bifrost granite tool lane (Lane B), not here.

outcome_history.task: U1 kb_dup_report: write one function that groups /retrieve chunks by collection and reports returned vs distinct counts. Strictly explicit brief, 5,458 B, seeded 16-case gate.
outcome_history.result: ARTIFACT CORRECT, RUN UNSCORABLE, twice. Both dispatches wrote a correct module at iteration 0 (16 passed, 0 failed of 16 when the gate was run by hand) and then took four 502s at iteration 1: 'router 502 (reply swallowed, NO content) for bifrost-1a-hearth', CASCADE_EXHAUSTED. FINAL: BLOCKED(router-error), attribution ABORTED-ENVIRONMENT (scorable=False).
outcome_history.finding: SINGLE ITERATION ONLY. This tier completes iteration 0 and returns empty content at iteration 1, which the router renders as a 502. The difference between the two iterations is prompt size, not task difficulty: iteration 1 carries the brief plus the system prompt plus the iteration-0 tool result. A small probe cannot detect this -- an 18-token call to the same alias through the same router returns READY at 78 tok/s, and /api/generate with num_predict=256 returns READY. Unloading and reloading the models did not help. Being strictly explicit fixes the CONTENT (measured 15/15 previously); it does not buy a second iteration.
outcome_history.route: Give this tier work that finishes in ONE write, with no verify-and-rewrite round trip. If a unit needs the lane to read a gate result and correct itself, send it to bifrost-granite (Lane B) or bifrost-t2-gemma4 (Lane A). When a run here ends BLOCKED, run the seeded gate by hand before discarding the artifact -- it may be complete.

_practices_doc: Practice registry for 8B-30B local-model authoring (DESIGN-practice-registry-8b30b-2026-07-29). Every entry is a MEASURED failure mode from demo banks -- provenance names the bank/graph that taught it. applies_to: which authored artifact the rule constrains (checker|code|tests|decompose). family: task families it is relevant to ('any' = always). status: prompt = injected text only; gate = also enforced deterministically in the verify path (the promotion target). Selection is TAG-BASED and deterministic -- never semantic retrieval.

practices.text: The entrypoint contract is main(argv: list[str]) -> int: it RETURNS exit codes and never raises. Judge returncode, never require SystemExit. Sole exception: argparse itself raises SystemExit(0) on --help/--version and SystemExit(2) on a malformed argument.
practices.provenance: v257 bank 6/6 test_help_flag SystemExit; v266 7/10 DID-NOT-RAISE; v274 smoke

practices.text: Parse output semantically: case-insensitive regex that allows surrounding text, float compares with tolerance. Never compare exact bytes, exact whitespace, capitalization, column order, or punctuation. Assert required VALUES and exit codes only.
practices.provenance: v276 bank: 11 checker over-strict rejections; v274: col_1-vs-age exact-string guesses

practices.text: The self-validation good example must be a TYPICAL passing case, not a corner case; the bad example must be unambiguously wrong (wrong value, not wrong phrasing).
practices.provenance: v276 over-strict checkers passed self-validation then rejected reasonable impls

practices.text: Never assume the entrypoint is named main. State the expected entry name, but callers must resolve it at runtime from a candidate list (declared entrypoint, spec function_name, main) and skip gracefully if none resolves.
practices.provenance: v277 bank: harness NameError 'main is not defined' sank s1 in 3+ takes
practices.status: gate (runtime globals() resolution in acceptance + snapshot harnesses)

practices.text: For tabular tasks, pin whether the header row counts with an explicit worked example (a file with a header + 3 data rows reports Rows: 3 -- data rows only, header excluded). Both the impl gate and the test must inherit this from the pinned example, never assume.
practices.provenance: v271-noS0: Rows-3-vs-4 assert failures; v273 smoke: 'Expected 2 rows, got 3' repair target

practices.text: Parse the argv you are GIVEN: parser.parse_args(argv), never argv[1:]. Golden calls pass args-only lists (main(['data.csv'])), with no program name at index 0.
practices.provenance: v269 bank: SystemExit(2) on every golden call after argv[1:] convention mismatch

practices.text: Handle errors by printing to stderr and RETURNING a nonzero int. Do not call sys.exit() inside the entrypoint; the __main__ shim owns process exit.
practices.provenance: v266/v274: return-vs-raise divergence between impl and test

practices.text: The implementation is textually prepended into your module: call its functions directly. Never import it by any name, never invoke a CLI via subprocess/os.system/runpy, never assert on a process returncode.
practices.provenance: pre-v257 banks: ModuleNotFoundError + returncode asserts failed every take

practices.text: Every test function takes ZERO parameters. The runner is stdlib-only: pytest fixtures (capsys, tmp_path, monkeypatch) are never injected and a parameterized test is scored as a FAILURE. Capture stdout with io.StringIO + contextlib.redirect_stdout; create fixture files with plain open().
practices.provenance: v264 bank graph 94335197: 4 attempts, byte-identical fixture-SKIP verdict each time

practices.text: Call ONLY names that literally appear in the implementation shown to you. Do not invent internal helpers (validate_path, parse_row, compute_stats). Test observable behaviour: return value, printed output, raised exceptions.
practices.provenance: 2026-07-26 banks: NameError validate_path every take; undefined-name gate era

practices.text: DO import what your tests use (pytest, os, io, tempfile, contextlib). The no-import rule applies ONLY to the implementation under test, which is already in your namespace.
practices.provenance: v258 bank: NameError pytest -- the import ban over-generalised

practices.text: Assert parsed values and patterns, never exact output phrasing the spec does not pin. If the spec is silent on wording, do not assert on it -- format conformance belongs to the acceptance checker and snapshot bind, not to guessed string literals.
practices.provenance: v277/v279: bare AssertionError exact-string failures against checker-verified impls

practices.text: Any tier hosting a code or test leg must have a cross-coder escalation fallback; a chain-end tier with no fallback turns one transient 502 into FAILED_NEEDS_HUMAN.
practices.provenance: v278 bank: s1-on-2.5 dead at attempt 1-2, takes 2/3/6; fixed by 2.5->2_qwen_coder map

practices.text: argparse ALREADY provides -h/--help automatically. NEVER call parser.add_argument("--help") -- it raises ArgumentError: conflicting option string and every call to the entrypoint fails. A spec that mentions a --help flag is satisfied by argparse's built-in one.
practices.provenance: v267 bank (A15 smoke-gate origin); recurred v283 R2c: 4/4 attempts, all tiers
practices.status: prompt+gate (smoke-call harness catches it; this entry PREVENTS it)

practices.text: Define the entrypoint function at MODULE level. NEVER nest def main inside if __name__ == "__main__": -- the module is imported by the verifier, the guard is False, the function is never defined, and every dependent test dies with NameError. The guard block should contain ONLY the call: sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:])).
practices.provenance: v284 R2d: s1 hid def main inside the __main__ guard; harness skip made it a vacuous pass; s4 3/3 NameError
practices.status: prompt+gate (acceptance harness now FAILS on unresolvable entry)
